spans.s: घ्रा vt. 1P (pp. घ्रात or घ्राण; pres. जिघ्रति) To smell, to perceive by odour, to smell at, लेढि जिघ्रति संक्षिप्य करोत्युन्नतमासनम् Bh.V.i.99, Bt.xv.109.(This verb is used with several prepositions without any material difference in meaning, Bt.ii.10, xiv.12, R.iii.3, i.43, xiii.70.)
घ्राण (II) n. 1. The act of smelling, घ्राणेन सूकरो हंति M.iii.241; 2. odour; 3. the nose, घ्राणं करेण विरुणद्धि Rt.vi.27, M.v.135.
घ्राण-इंद्रिय n. the organ or sense of smell; (नासाग्रवर्ति according to Vaiśeṣikas).
घ्राण-चक्षुस् a. using the nose for eyes, blind.
घ्राण-तर्पण a. pleasant to the nose, fragrant.
घ्राति f. 1. The nose; 2. the act of smelling, घ्रातिरघ्रेयमद्ययोः M.xi.67.
